verdict.rationale: The evidence shows an MCP server, a plugin API, an RPC/OpenAPI backend and component-copy propagation. None of it documents a first-party capability to perform bulk operations across many items at once. These are developer building blocks or adjacent features (main-component updates reflecting to copies), so they earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
